assessment.basis_code: Conditional equal-pressure-weight joint PVT agreement within published parameter widths; source confidence and covariance are unspecified.
qualifications: Fei original new observations, paired Pt/Au volumes, full source selection, weights, covariance and unrounded inputs not recovered. Cold unweighted fits can agree with individual published error widths without reproducing the original regression or joint uncertainty region. Only prior-table source errors permit source-error-weighted comparisons. Hot source errors and temperature errors are absent; no source-error-weighted hot fit is possible. Effective error weights use slopes of the published model, ignore shared calibration correlations and retain each table's original pressure/volume errors. Finger 293 K pressures are preserved on the original Piermarini scale; Fei explicitly recalibrates Hemley only. Assigning Finger to 300 K is a documented diagnostic choice. Curve agreement validates an equation/normalization at plotted conditions; it establishes neither exact original-regression recovery nor absolute pressure accuracy. Dewaele (2008) note29 discusses a 0 K reinterpretation and contains a self-referential citation typo. Fei Eq.3 and the Figure5 cold curve remain the authority for the retained 300 K subtraction. Published q error is 0.3; source confidence level and covariance are unspecified. No thermal diagnostic replaces published q=0.6.

superseded_record_text.label: Fei et al PNAS 2007 [BM3]
superseded_record_text.notes: Published Fei et al. (2007) cold branch with the common Table 1 Ne MGD thermal parameters and Eq. 3 printed variable-exponent theta law, relative to 300 K. V0=88.967 A^3 is the fixed four-atom conventional fcc-cell volume for both branches; K0 and K0-prime remain specific to the cold equation. V0, theta0 and gamma0 are adopted source parameters; q=0.6(3) is retained with unspecified confidence/covariance. The room-temperature fit combined Finger (1981), Hemley (1989, recalculated to Dewaele 2004 ruby) and new Fei Pt/Au observations. All 14 Finger and 21 Hemley table rows, 13 separable new 300 K markers and six new 1000 K Pt-scale markers are bundled. Complete new rows, paired calibrant volumes and original weights are unrecovered. The 2000 K curve is a calculated extrapolation. See docs/literature-reproductions/fei-2007-neon.md; diagnostics do not replace published coefficients. Reported overall range is about 4.7-115 GPa; digitized/table recalculated endpoints carry their own rounding and can extend slightly above 115 GPa.
